exact_object_or_asset: Main scene media path and hosting: RemoteMediaConfig + video controllers
current_issue: Seven VideoPlayers are present; components have no direct clips/URLs in scene audit and scripts resolve runtime URLs. Large videos exist in Assets and remote resolver is configured. Broken or local fallback media can cause stalls or failed playback in WebGL.
proposed_replacement_or_action: Finalize CDN URLs and keep large videos out of the player data/StreamingAssets where possible; validate every configured filename.
expected_benefit: High: reduces download/player package pressure and avoids browser video decode/load failures.
visual_impact: None if URLs point to same encoded media
how_to_validate: Network tab shows videos fetched on demand; no video files in WebGL data payload; playback works after cache clear.

current_issue: 1,939 of 2,046 renderers cast shadows while only 2 realtime lights exist and no baked lights are recorded.
proposed_replacement_or_action: Bake static lighting where possible; disable realtime shadows on small clutter, flowers, distant foliage, exhibit props, and architectural pieces whose shadows are not perceptible.
expected_benefit: High: reduces shadow-pass draw calls and vertex work; likely more valuable than replacing wall meshes.
visual_impact: Low to medium depending on aggressive cuts
how_to_validate: Frame Debugger/Profiler: shadow caster draws drop; compare before/after frame time in WebGL build.

current_issue: 2,046 renderers, 2,140 material slots, 305 unique materials; only 81 static-batching/occlusion-static renderers.
proposed_replacement_or_action: Group static home/environment meshes by material, atlas repeated materials, mark occluders/occludees, use SRP Batcher-compatible materials, and instance repeated vegetation/flowers where applicable.
expected_benefit: High on WebGL because CPU/draw-call overhead often dominates before raw geometry.
how_to_validate: Profiler: Batches/SetPass calls drop; scene totals show more static/occlusion candidates.

current_issue: Build-enabled scenes reference ~596 MB runtime texture memory before engine/WASM overhead; texture streaming disabled; several 2048 textures are used once.
proposed_replacement_or_action: Add WebGL platform texture overrides; cap small/secondary props at 512-1024, compress normal/mask maps appropriately, enable mipmap streaming if camera use supports it.
expected_benefit: High: lowers memory pressure and initial GPU uploads.
visual_impact: Low if caps are chosen by asset importance
how_to_validate: Memory Profiler and browser memory show reduced texture memory; visual spot-check cultural media/artwork.

exact_object_or_asset: High-poly exhibit artifacts: metal_table_asset.glb, LL_PhotoAlbum.glb, glass_fish.glb, japanese_red_bridge.glb, drum.glb
current_issue: Top five source assets contribute ~1.50M triangles, over half of main renderer triangles.
proposed_replacement_or_action: Decimate or LOD these objects; keep close-up hero versions only where inspected; add impostor/low LOD for distant states.
expected_benefit: High/valuable: these are much larger geometry wins than wall replacement.
visual_impact: Medium for culturally important artifacts; validate carefully
how_to_validate: Triangle count and visible triangles drop; compare close-view screenshots.

current_issue: Terrain adds an estimated 524k triangles; quality uses terrain detail/tree distances and 66 trees.
proposed_replacement_or_action: Raise terrain pixel error for WebGL, tune detail/tree draw distances, use billboards/impostors for distant vegetation, simplify terrain layers.
expected_benefit: Medium to high, especially on lower-powered browsers.
how_to_validate: Profiler terrain render time drops; no visible popping at intended routes.

exact_object_or_asset: Idyllic Italian Coast Town structural subset
current_issue: Main scene uses ~108.6k structural triangles from wall_base, wall_pillar, roof, floor, street, plus ~25k prop/fence triangles.
proposed_replacement_or_action: Keep visible architecture but simplify repeated pillars/walls and merge/atlas materials; replace only decorative/noninteractive flat pieces with baked textures/decals.
expected_benefit: Medium at most: about 4.9% of renderer triangles, but 216 renderers add draw-call/shadow overhead.
visual_impact: Medium if nearby geometry loses depth/parallax
how_to_validate: Compare triangle/renderers/shadow casters for Italian source assets; screenshot roof/pillars/stairs.

exact_object_or_asset: Structural walls/floors/ceilings as wholesale sprite conversion
current_issue: Nearby architecture requires collision, parallax, shadows, and first-person/XR depth.
proposed_replacement_or_action: Do not convert primary structural walls, floors, ceilings, porches, stairs, and nearby windows/doors to sprites. Use meshes/planes with baked detail instead.
expected_benefit: Low relative to risk; artifacts would be visible.
how_to_validate: A/B camera path check for parallax/depth artifacts.

current_issue: 147 wall_base renderers total 44.1k triangles; each is only 300 triangles.
proposed_replacement_or_action: Prefer combining/static batching/material consolidation over remodelling every piece.
expected_benefit: Low to medium; renderer count matters more than mesh complexity here.
how_to_validate: Batches drop more than triangles; visual unchanged.

current_issue: Disabled from Build Settings and Addressables remote group contains `BlackKitchen_MemoryScene`; scene has 676k triangles, 27 renderers, 7 materials, 0 mesh colliders.
proposed_replacement_or_action: Keep remote/additive strategy; optimize scanned mesh/textures only if its remote bundle is too large or WebGL memory spikes during exhibit entry.
expected_benefit: Not part of initial main player cost if Addressables are built/deployed correctly.
how_to_validate: Addressables report and runtime memory before/after loading exhibit.
